name: labs/l-johnston__tekinstr
title: Tektronix MDO3000 series oscilloscope (tekinstr.Oscilloscope)
intro: Tektronix MDO3000 series oscilloscope (tekinstr.Oscilloscope), adapted from l-johnston/tekinstr. It reads `sample_rate`, `acquisition_count` and `trigger_state`; sets `record_length`, `horizontal_scale`, `horizontal_delay_mode`, `acquisition_mode` and 3 more; runs `force_trigger`. `force_trigger`: force a trigger event and report the trigger state afterwards. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/l-johnston__tekinstr --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/l-johnston__tekinstr --backend fake --mcp
